mapper.sql:
select min(base.order_id) as id, base.school_id as school_id, base.supplier_name as unit_name, concat(base.school_name, '家长端订单结算') as project_name, base.settlement_cycle, case when sum(case when base.settled_flag = 0 then base.net_amount else 0 end) = 0 then '2' when sum(case when base.settled_flag = 1 then base.net_amount else 0 end) = 0 then '0' else '1' end as status, sum(base.net_amount) as settlement_amount, null as withdraw_no, base.supplier_name as supplier_name, base.supplier_id as supplier_id, sum(case when base.settled_flag = 1 then base.net_amount else 0 end) as apply_amount, max(base.last_settlement_time) as apply_time, 0 as tax_amount, sum(case when base.settled_flag = 1 then base.net_amount else 0 end) as paid_amount, sum(case when base.settled_flag = 0 then base.net_amount else 0 end) as unpaid_amount, base.dept_id as dept_id, null as create_by, min(base.order_create_time) as create_time, null as update_by, max(base.last_settlement_time) as update_time, concat( '订单', count(1), '笔；已结算', sum(case when base.settled_flag = 1 then 1 else 0 end), '笔；待结算', sum(case when base.settled_flag = 0 then 1 else 0 end), '笔' ) as remark, '0' as del_flag from (
) base group by base.school_id, base.school_name, base.supplier_id, base.supplier_name, base.settlement_cycle, base.dept_id
mapper.select:
select coalesce(sum(s.settlement_amount), 0) as settlement_amount, 0 as tax_amount, coalesce(sum(s.paid_amount), 0) as paid_amount, coalesce(sum(s.unpaid_amount), 0) as unpaid_amount, count(1) as total_count, sum(case when s.status = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as pending_count, sum(case when s.status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as partial_count, sum(case when s.status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as settled_count from (
) s where 1 = 1 and s.unit_name like concat('%', #{unitName}, '%') and s.supplier_name like concat('%', #{supplierName}, '%') and s.project_name like concat('%', #{projectName}, '%') and s.settlement_cycle = #{settlementCycle} and s.status = #{status}
